summary: FIG.01–06 Founder Nexus AAA rebuild PASS full-stack. BACKEND (15/15 pytest test_nexus_founder_starter_iter148.py): GET /api/nexus/avatars returns EXACTLY av_ninja + av_ninja_f as active (legacy starters gone), av_ninja is_default=true, my_glow present; both starters carry all 7 animation_urls (idle/walk/run/jump/fall/land/greet). POST /api/nexus/avatars/starter {av_ninja_f, violet} → ok, subsequent GET shows my_id=av_ninja_f, my_glow=violet; wallet balance unchanged (NO FP burn on starter save). Invalid id 'av_x' → 422, invalid color 'pink' → 422. POST /avatars/glow {cyan} → ok. FOUNDER (stealth): /avatars/collection returns founder_vault=true with all 6 premium avatars unlocked=true; POST /avatars/av_void_wizard/unlock returns {founder_vault or already_unlocked, burned:0} with wallet unchanged; /avatars/select av_void_wizard → 200. All 6 premium avatars carry the full 7-animation set via /collection. REGULAR (auditcheckreal): founder_vault absent/false; /avatars/select on a locked premium → 403. Regression: /nexus/world version=28 (>=28 OK); /nexus/public 200; /nexus/join 200. FRONTEND (mobile 390x780 + maxTouchPoints=5 init script): /nexus renders nexus-starter-chooser with MALE NINJA + FEMALE NINJA cards both labeled FREE, all 9 named glow swatches (nexus-glow-lime…white) present and label matches; SAVE AVATAR (nexus-starter-save) triggers toast 'Starter Ninja saved'. Enter world: nexus-rotate-popup appears with nexus-rotate-notnow + nexus-rotate-btn; NOT NOW dismisses cleanly and popup does not re-appear same session. In-world nexus-settings panel contains GRAPHICS QUALITY nexus-gfx-slider with all 5 stops nexus-gfx-{low,bal,high,ultra,max}, warning text 'Higher quality may load slower or crash.' present in nexus-gfx-warning; clicking nexus-gfx-high toggles aria-checked from low→high and updates window.__NEXUS_USER_TIER='high' without URL/page reload; closing settings hides the panel. World actually renders (mobile screenshot shows avatar, NEXUS CENTRAL HUD, JUMP/INTERACT/EXIT, joystick, chat/emote). Founder AvatarCollection (stealth): founder-vault-banner present with 'FOUNDER AVATAR VAULT' and 'ALL AVATARS UNLOCKED' text; zero avatar-unlock-* burn buttons rendered; SELECT buttons visible for premium tiles (5 select controls detected — 6th is the currently equipped av_void_wizard shown as EQUIPPED). Cleanup: auditcheckreal was restored to a sane starter state (final zz test).
critical_code_review_comments: routers/nexus.py is now 970 lines — still well over the 700-line guideline flagged in iter146. Recommend splitting avatar-studio (starter+glow+collection+unlock+select), founder-vault helpers, magic/join/presence, and admin into sub-routers.

avatar_unlock still lacks a unique index on (user_id, avatar_id) in db.nexus_avatar_unlocks; the DuplicateKeyError refund path in the code is dead until that index exists. For founder users this is safe (grant is idempotent via upsert+setOnInsert), but the FP-burn concurrency hole flagged in iter146 remains for regular users. Add ensureIndex at startup.
AVATAR_FP_COSTS is still a hardcoded Python dict; consider moving to a config collection for pricing agility (repeat of iter146 comment).

/api/nexus/avatars/starter uses status=='active' filter — the migration has archived legacy starters (starter_m/starter_f/av_d5b60b3e) but that leaves the door open for future data drift; consider also enforcing a boolean is_starter flag on the doc so the endpoint's whitelist ({av_ninja, av_ninja_f}) and DB status are guarded by the same invariant.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested FIG.01–06 checks (starter chooser+glow+save toast, rotate popup NOT NOW dismiss, 5-stop GFX slider + warning + tier switch without reload, founder-vault-banner, world entry with no black screen)
